zones.title: Trigger
zones.body: Every 5 minutes. Scans the current session for bar gaps and repairs them from the same feed. Quiet with no manifest. Covers OPEN..CLOSE+30m.

zones.title: Detect + plan
zones.body: Build the expected minute grid per session symbol and diff against bar_versions. A no-trade minute is not a transport gap, so nothing is fabricated. Plan emits one bounded window, or zero items when there is nothing to do.

zones.title: Claim + fetch + append
zones.body: Lease-fenced so two runs cannot repair the same window. Fetch the gap window from Alpaca, insert only the missing bars (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); recovered bars keep their real available_at, never backdated. Close the job with the repaired count.
